content: {DRAFT } If ComMPncGatewayEnabled is set to TRUE and when the P NC Learning Phase is active and an PNC bit in the ERA is set to “1” on a channel where ComMDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled is set to TRUE ComM shall set PNC - to - channel Mapping to 1 for every ComMPnc on the according channel where this PNC bit in the ERA has been set to “ 1 ” for the according PNC.
